summary: Tesla revealed the second-generation Roadster on 15 October 2026 near Waco, Texas. Ten cold-gas thrusters fed by 600 litres of compressed air lifted it up an inverted ramp, spun it and hopped it over other Tesla vehicles. Production is promised for 2028; reservations cost $50,000 (Performance) and $250,000 (Thrust). Physics analysts say cold-gas thrust lasts seconds, so it is a hop, not sustained flight; no FAA approval has been reported. Musk said safety 'is not the main goal'.
